Counts match spec: 45/66 stock>0 and 44/66 sales>0. Sample ASIN B0CBRY2VGX shows Stock:37, Sales:17 in both backend response and UI. UI displays STK (green) and SLS (purple) columns between MODEL and QTY. Sortable headers work. Status banner shows 'Stock data included. Sales data included.'

Backend: ASIN B0CBRY2VGX -> Stock=37, Sales=17 (matches expected)
Frontend renders STK (green bg) and SLS (purple bg) columns between MODEL and QTY

Click on STK column header triggers sorting (no errors)
Status notification confirms 'Stock data included' & 'Sales data included'
notes: Test script had a minor case-sensitive header check ('Stk' vs rendered 'STK') that printed an assertion error; screenshot and DOM dump confirm columns are correct. No product issue.
